images.alt: Пластиковый кессон для скважины в котловане на дачном участке
images.prompt: Black ribbed polyethylene well caisson about 1.2 m in diameter standing in a freshly dug round pit on a Russian dacha plot, steel well casing pipe rising through the bottom, sandy soil walls, shovel and wheelbarrow nearby, overcast autumn day

images.alt: Пластиковый и металлический кессоны для скважины рядом перед установкой
images.prompt: Two well caissons side by side on grass before installation: a black ribbed plastic caisson and a cylindrical steel caisson painted with dark protective coating, both with a round neck and lid, garden fence in background, daylight

images.alt: Монтаж кессона: обсадная труба проходит через гильзу в днище, пазухи засыпают песком
images.prompt: Installation of a plastic well caisson in a pit: the well casing pipe passes through a sealed sleeve in the caisson bottom, workers in boots backfilling the space around the caisson with sand from a wheelbarrow, view from above at an angle, daylight

images.alt: Утепление крышки кессона плитами экструдированного пенополистирола
images.prompt: Round lid of a well caisson being insulated: grey-blue extruded polystyrene foam boards cut to fit and laid on top of the lid and around the neck, gloved hands pressing a board, cut-off pieces and a utility knife nearby, autumn leaves on the ground

images.alt: Оборудование в кессоне: оголовок скважины, кран, фильтр и реле давления
images.prompt: Inside view of a well caisson from the open hatch: well head on the steel casing, blue ball valve, filter with a transparent bowl, pressure switch with gauge and a small blue pressure tank on a stand, ladder on the wall, flashlight lighting

images.alt: Горловина кессона с утеплённой крышкой над газоном зимой
images.prompt: Insulated round hatch of a well caisson rising slightly above a snow-covered lawn of a country house garden, a small vent pipe next to it, frosty winter morning, low sun
